debugging.name: Debug & Fix Issues
debugging.description: Help identify and fix bugs, errors, or unexpected behavior

questions.question: What type of error are you encountering?
What is the exact error message (if any)?
What behavior did you expect?
What is actually happening?
What steps reproduce the issue?
What have you already tried?

feature_implementation.name: Implement New Feature
feature_implementation.description: Build new functionality from scratch or extend existing code

questions.question: Describe the feature you want to build:
What user problem does this solve? (As a [user], I want [goal] so that [benefit])
What are the acceptance criteria? (List specific requirements)
Are there any technical constraints or requirements?
Is there existing code this needs to integrate with?
options: Yes, but it's in my project files

questions.question: What testing is required?

code_review.name: Code Review & Improvement
code_review.description: Get feedback on code quality, patterns, and best practices

questions.question: What aspects should the review focus on?
Do you have any specific concerns about this code?
What does this code do? (Brief description)
Is this intended for production use?

refactoring.name: Refactor Existing Code
refactoring.description: Improve code structure, readability, or performance

questions.question: What is the primary goal of this refactoring?
What issues exist in the current code?
Must the external API/interface remain unchanged?
Are there any constraints on the refactoring scope?

explanation.name: Explain Code/Concept
explanation.description: Understand how code works or learn a programming concept

questions.question: What do you need explained?
What is your experience level with this topic?
What specific aspects are confusing?
Why do you need to understand this? (Context helps tailor explanation)

testing.name: Write Tests
testing.description: Create unit tests, integration tests, or test strategies

questions.question: What type of tests do you need?
What testing framework should be used?
What level of test coverage do you need?
Are there specific edge cases to consider?

api_design.name: Design API/Interface
api_design.description: Design REST APIs, function interfaces, or module contracts

questions.question: What type of API/interface are you designing?
What are the main use cases this API must support?
Who/what will consume this API?
Are there any constraints (auth, rate limiting, versioning)?

optimization.name: Optimize Performance
optimization.description: Improve code performance, memory usage, or efficiency

questions.question: What are you trying to optimize?
What is the current performance? (metrics if available)
What is your target performance?
Are there any constraints (can't change algorithm, limited refactoring)?

refinement_prompts.missing_context: I notice some context might be helpful. Could you provide: {missing_items}
refinement_prompts.clarify_goal: To give you the best solution, I'd like to clarify: {question}
refinement_prompts.suggest_approach: Based on your requirements, I'd suggest: {approach}. Would you like me to proceed with this, or would you prefer a different approach?
refinement_prompts.too_broad: Your request covers several areas. Let's focus on one at a time. Which would you like to start with: {options}
